title: I want to dive deeper into cinema

commenti.body: Start by subscribing to the Criterion Channel! They have a great catalogue of classics, foreign films and special themed collections (right now there’s a bunch of horror movies since it’s October). The Sight & Sound list of greatest films is also a good place to start though your mileage may vary on some of the slower-paced titles (I personally found it challenging to get through Jeanne Dielman, 23 Commerce Quay, 1080 Brussels, for example).
